description: Everyday care questions the 동물사랑배움터 guides cover (2026-10-19), written before measuring the care-guide search (src/tools/care_guides.py). 'guide' names the guide and page holding the answer, checked in the page text. Caveat: GUIDE_FLOOR was chosen on 12 probe questions, and g01, g02, g04, g12, g15 and g16 are close to six of them, so those six are not independent of the floor. 'expected' is answer for all. Run with scripts/evaluate_crag.py --questions like basic_care_questions.json, scored by reading whether the answer gives the fact and names the guide.
